name: shu-yang-yang
description: 数羊羊 — 数羊助眠、睡眠质量监测、分析与个性化建议，支持 iOS / Android / 手表 / 戒指

scripts.sync:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.mobile:android: npm run sync:android && npm run open:android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run sync:ios && npm run open:ios
scripts.ios:build: npm run sync:ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' build
